Enjoyable dinner
Nov 2019 • Family
We liked the food at this restaurant so much that we went there for dinner two nights in a row. The sashimi was fresh. The fried rice was fragrant. Salmon donburi was delicious. Couldn't resist ordering their Karaage. We were so full after the meal but so contented.

Tasty food at affordable prices
Feb 2019 • Friends
We came here for late dinner. The menu was good and prices were affordable for tourists. We ordered drinks and food. Wait time was a little but was to be expected. The drinks came however there was a mix up with our drinks. This was easily sorted and staff were friendly around this. The food arrived in a timely manner and was tasty and filling. Flavours were great was happy with the meal. Well worth a look if you are in the area.

Best tonkatsu in Ho Chi Minh City
Apr 2018
The owner has to be Japanese to make pork cutlet like this. Bringing a mortar and pestle to grind sesame??? Nobody in Saigon does this but it adds so much umami to the tonkatsu. 

I always order the rose katsu. It’s such a succulent piece of deep fried pork steak. Dip into the tonkatsu and crushed sesame.. this is pork bliss. 

Just go here and eat.

One of the best Katsu restaurants in Town
Dec 2017 • Solo
I am quite peaky in taste, but this is one of the best katsu restaurants in this Town. Exceptionally good service comes along with smiling staff. 

One thing I was not very comfortable with was that there is no ventilation system that gets rid of smoking smells. I was very enjoying my meal until a smoker sits next to me and keeps smoking for around 20 minutes. 

Food ☆☆☆☆☆
Service ☆☆☆☆☆
Environment ☆☆☆
(lacking solution for the smoking cigarettes)

Good food at a great price.
May 2014 • Friends
We found the staff very helpful and the service was good. We were not rushed but they came immediately if we wanted something.
We came on this place by chance after looking for a recommend restaurant which turned out to be too expensive. Four of us at here and all ordered different types of Japanese food. The food was well cooked and plentiful, drinks prices were very reasonable and tax and service was included in the price.
The setting is not great but it is only supposed to be a cafe style place. It was clean and well tended.

Excellent Service and Delicious Food
Nov 2013 • Couples
